children: Binance co-CEO Yi He said in a post on X that withdrawals are currently running fairly smoothly, though congestion cannot be ruled out if request volumes pile up, after which processing should ease again.
She also urged users to check withdrawal addresses carefully and to verify the security of any new device and environment before transacting, closing with: "Safety first.💁🏻‍♀️"

title: Yi He Says Withdrawals Running Fairly Smoothly, Warns of Possible Congestion
